card.name: Words before disclaimer and risk phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as 'an' or 'those' just before 'increased risk' or 'other sites' in warning and disclaimer text. Also fires partway through brand names like TIBSOVO and TREANDA.

modes.label: Linking word before risk
modes.description: The word 'an' right before 'increased risk' in boxed warnings and trial summaries.
modes.example: treated with antipsychotic drugs are at<< an>> increased

modes.label: Website disclaimer wording
modes.description: Words inside standard legal disclaimers about links, endorsement and copyright.
modes.example: they do not constitute endorsements of<< those>> other sites.

modes.label: Inside brand names
modes.description: Middle pieces of capitalized drug brand names in dosing text.
modes.example: If a dose of TIB<<SO>>VO is vomited
